{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA believes the Occupy Wall Street movement could broaden its social base by demanding that the United States government strictly regulate the financial sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes the United States government should enact effective progressive income and corporate taxation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes the United States government should cut an oversized imperial “defense budget”.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Cutting the “defense budget” would enable the funding of a massive public jobs program, Medicare for all, an end to foreclosures, substantial investment in clean energy, and an end to student debt.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports a massive public jobs program as outlined in HR 2914, Rep. Jan Schakowsky’s (D-IL) $227 billion “Emergency Jobs to Restore the American Dream Act”.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Both HR 870 and HR 2914 would fund massive public jobs programs in industries such as green improvements, rebuilding of infrastructure and expansion of mass transit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The jobs programs would target jobs for communities with the highest unemployment levels, such as urban communities of color and rural communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The jobs programs would be funded through progressive revenue enhancements, including a financial transactions tax.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA recognizes that economic recovery is not possible absent an aggressive federal program to end foreclosures.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
